commit.message:
DOC-7059: Migrate develop/reference+setup to render hooks

Converts relref links and note/warning/tip/info/alert callouts across
content/develop/reference/ (incl. nested eviction/ and modules/),
content/develop/setup/, and content/develop/_index.md, via
build/migrate_shortcode_links.py. reference/protocol-spec.md had four
DOC-7055-flagged percent-form `{{% alert title="..." %}}` callouts, all
converted correctly (titles matching the type's default label dropped,
others preserved). Three files had no shortcodes to convert. Central
href-diff and build-warning verification against main, batched with this
migration's other DOC-7059 units, came back clean (0 diffs).

Ticket: DOC-7059
Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
